operator_visible_outcome: The final Production layout has no migration state and every obsolete package path is rejected

inputs.validation: Bounded tracked paths, Go modules, packages, imports and architecture policy

outputs.validation: Deterministic acceptance or rejection with a bounded diagnostic

canonical_state: The final declared package, command, worker, tool and fixture layout is fixed without migration exceptions
derived_state: Final Product layout verdict and independent Assurance verdict

authorities.grant: Accept only the final declared layout and dependency direction
authorities.refusal: Reject an obsolete package path, undeclared owner or forbidden dependency

authorities.grant: Independently enforce the final layout and dependency direction
authorities.refusal: Reject migration state, a weaker Production policy or recreated obsolete path

trust_boundaries.treatment: Compare the tracked tree and Go imports with the final architecture policy
Compare bounded Production policy data with independently compiled final-path rules

resources.acquisition: Read one bounded NUL-delimited tracked-file inventory
resources.bound: At most 100000 paths, 16777216 aggregate source bytes and 30000 milliseconds
resources.release: Release inventory and parsed syntax when policy evaluation returns
resources.cleanup_failure: Return an infrastructure error without accepting the tree

resources.acquisition: Read one bounded strict architecture policy document
resources.bound: At most 1048576 bytes with no migration fields
resources.release: Release decoded policy when independent evaluation returns
resources.cleanup_failure: Return an assurance error without accepting the tree

platforms.evidence: Native Production and Assurance policy execution

invariants.statement: The final Production layout contains only declared owners and dependency directions
invariants.boundary: Go package import to authority owner
invariants.falsifier: An undeclared owner, obsolete module identity or forbidden dependency passes policy
invariants.residual_uncertainty: Dynamic loading is outside this static import boundary

invariants.statement: The policy schema contains no migration registry or migration-only state
invariants.falsifier: A migration field is accepted or an obsolete path is recreated
invariants.residual_uncertainty: No compatibility or migration state remains

invariants.statement: The final layout preserves end-to-end operation and platform semantics
invariants.boundary: Use-case orchestration to governed dependencies and caller result
invariants.falsifier: Diagnostics copy worker text, failure dimensions collapse or an unsupported platform reaches side effects

assurance_controls.owner: governed URL rulepack and architecture check

invariants.residual_uncertainty: Native Windows execution and non-Windows refusal remain bounded by their qualified contracts

success_semantics: Accepted means only final owners exist, obsolete roots are rejected and operation semantics remain unchanged
refusal_semantics: An undeclared owner, forbidden edge, obsolete root or migration field returns a bounded rejection
failure_semantics: Malformed policy, parse failure or unavailable required tooling fails the gate
cancellation_semantics: Cancellation stops evaluation and cannot produce acceptance
indeterminate_semantics: Missing or contradictory evidence cannot produce acceptance
recovery_semantics: Rerun from the unchanged tracked inventory; no partial policy result is canonical
compatibility_or_reset_policy: Unused pre-release surfaces are removed outright; no compatibility reader, forwarding package, alias, shim or dual implementation is retained
falsifiers: An undeclared owner or obsolete module identity passes policy
An obsolete package path is recreated without rejection
Diagnostics, failure distinctions or unsupported-platform refusal change

assurance_controls.owner: governed URL rulepack and architecture check

residual_limitations: This layout freeze does not establish new operation behaviour
Native Windows execution remains separately governed
Exact-pair sign-off requires committed clean Product and Assurance candidates
non_goals: Change orchestration, diagnostics, failure classification or platform refusal
Create compatibility support, migration state or a duplicate implementation
Move, split or rename another package
Change admission, transformation, protocol, persistence, supervision or worker behaviour
deletion_criteria: Delete this slice contract only when a later reviewed contract explicitly supersedes the final-layout rule
